title: 2374. Node With Highest Edge Score

examples.explanation: - The nodes 1, 2, 3 and 4 have an edge pointing to node 0. The edge score of node 0 is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10. - The node 0 has an edge pointing to node 1. The edge score of node 1 is 0. - The node 7 has an edge pointing to node 5. The edge score of node 5 is 7. - The nodes 5 and 6 have an edge pointing to node 7. The edge score of node 7 is 5 + 6 = 11. Node 7 has the highest edge score so return 7.

- The nodes 1 and 2 have an edge pointing to node 0. The edge score of node 0 is 1 + 2 = 3. - The nodes 0 and 3 have an edge pointing to node 2. The edge score of node 2 is 0 + 3 = 3. Nodes 0 and 2 both have an edge score of 3. Since node 0 has a smaller index, we return 0.
